title: Integrating network pharmacology and experimental verification to explore the mechanism of Tripterygium wilfordii in ankylosing spondylitis.
authors: Chen, Yuening; Liu, Zhaoyi; Yu, Qing; Qu, Xinning; Liu, Hongxiao
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究雷公藤甲素治疗强直性脊柱炎，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to validate the mechanism of triptolide in treating ankylosing spondylitis (AS) through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vitro experiments. METHODS: We gathered AS-related genes using databases including DrugBank, OMIM, GeneCards, TTD and DisGeNET. TCMSP database was used to collect Tripterygium wilfordii (TWHF)-related data. Additionally, the potential targets of TWHF in treating AS were predicted by consulting databases such as Venny, String, Cytoscape, and Cytohubba. Subsequently, a protein-protein interaction network was created and the gene ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment analysis were performed by metascape database. After selecting the most active ingredient of TWHF, molecular docking was performed to confirm the predicted results. Furthermore, we explore the potential mechanism of the most active ingredient of TWHF in the treatment of AS in vitro. RESULT: By integrating the results of network pharmacological analysis, 62 genes were found to be strongly associated with AS, such as STAT3, TNF, MMP9, VEGFA, CXCL8, PTGS2, etc. Triptolide (TP) is one of the most active ingredients in TWHF. The enrichment analysis indicated that 292 biological processes and 132 signaling pathways were involved, with the T helper 17 cells cell differentiation pathway as the key pathway. TP was selected for molecular docking and in vitro experiments. The molecular docking results indicated that TP had excellent affinity with 6 key targets. Further, flow cytometry, cell counting assay, and ELISA demonstrated that the serum level of IL-17 was higher in AS patients compared to XXX, and 25 mug/mL TP was the optimal intervention concentration. RT-qPCR and Western blotting further verified that TP could inhibit the activation of RORgammat and the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, based on network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental verification in vitro, we proposed that the TP can inhibit the activation of RORgammat and the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway and inhibit the differentiation of T helper 17 cells cells. The article provide a theoretical basis for further development and utilization of TWHF in AS management.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在通过网络药理学、分子对接及体外实验验证雷公藤甲素治疗强直性脊柱炎（ankylosing spondylitis, AS）的机制。方法：我们利用DrugBank、OMIM、GeneCards、TTD和DisGeNET等数据库收集AS相关基因。采用TCMSP数据库收集雷公藤（Tripterygium wilfordii, TWHF）相关数据。此外，通过查阅Venny、String、Cytoscape和Cytohubba等数据库，预测TWHF治疗AS的潜在靶点。随后，构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，并通过metascape数据库进行基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书富集分析。在筛选出TWHF最活性成分后，进行分子对接以确认预测结果。进一步，我们在体外探讨TWHF最活性成分治疗AS的潜在机制。结果：通过整合网络药理学分析结果，发现62个基因与AS密切相关，如STAT3、TNF、MMP9、VEGFA、CXCL8、PTGS2等。雷公藤甲素（triptolide, TP）是TWHF中最活性成分之一。富集分析表明涉及292个生物过程和132条信号通路，其中T辅助17细胞分化通路为关键通路。选择TP进行分子对接和体外实验。分子对接结果显示TP与6个关键靶点具有优异亲和力。进一步，流式细胞术、细胞计数实验和ELISA表明，AS患者血清中IL-17水平高于XXX，且25 μg/mL TP为最佳干预浓度。RT-qPCR和Western blotting进一步验证TP可抑制RORγt及JAK2/STAT3信号通路的激活。结论：总之，基于网络药理学、分子对接及体外实验验证，我们提出TP可抑制RORγt和JAK2/STAT3信号通路的激活，并抑制T辅助17细胞的分化。本文为TWHF在AS管理中进一步开发与利用提供了理论基础。
